question: Which deficit reflects the borrowing needs of the government?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fiscal deficit**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Fiscal deficit** represents the **total borrowing requirements **of the government.
 
• It is the difference between the government's total expenditure and its total revenue excluding borrowings.
